Jill — thanks, and welcome. Attaching a short intake checklist I use for new pilots. High level next steps from our side:
- Template: we'll start from Redwood Master Services Agreement (v2025.11) unless you ask us to use your MSA. If Starlite prefers its MSA, please flag now — we can run a side-by-side but it adds time.
- Legal reviewer: Kimberly Park (CC'd) owns commercial redlines. Marissa in Legal will triage any IP/specific liability asks.
- Signer: For pilots our product lead typically signs the Order Form; legal can sign MSA if there are material commercial changes. We'll confirm the signer roster once we have the Party_Roster.
- Security: please send the SPEC questions; we can respond with SOC2 evidence where applicable and a short on-call with security if needed.

Deliverables & rough timeline I propose:
1) Party roster + contact info from Starlite (reply to this thread with the attached spreadsheet filled) — by EOD Tue 4/21
2) Redwood initial redlines (commercial) — by Fri 4/24
3) 15–30m legal sync if redlines need clarification — Mon 4/27

Kimberly/Marissa/Karthik: please confirm availability for the 4/24 redline delivery and whether you want a canary/categorized redline (commercial v. high-risk clauses first).

Avery Johnson

On Tue, Apr 20, 2026 at 10:05 AM Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jill — thanks, and welcome. Attaching a short intake checklist I use for new pilots. High level next steps from our side:

Quick points from Legal:
- We will start from our Redwood MSA (v2025.11) and prepare a clean-side redline showing proposed commercial terms. If Starlite sends its MSA, point us to the canonical file and we'll run a comparison.
- Please populate and return the Party_Roster_Starlite.xlsx. We need legal names, legal entity, billing entity, and signing authority for each party. If Starlite uses multiple affiliates, call those out now.
- For the SOW: please mark any non-standard obligations (e.g., data residency, higher retention, special SLAs) inline — we'll handle scope as exhibit to the Order Form.
- If there are export/residency constraints in the Network_SA_Specs.pdf, flag them in the roster so we can route for privacy review early.

Redline approach:
- Priority 1 (commercial): payment terms, term/termination, liability cap, confidentiality scope.
- Priority 2 (operational): SLAs, support, onboarding timelines.
- Priority 3 (technical/security): data handling, residency, audit rights (coordinate with SecOps).

We expect to publish the initial commercial redline (tracked changes) by 2026-04-24 COB. If we see significant non-standard clauses in your MSA/SOW we'll call out which items would delay sign-off.

Attaching: Party_Roster_Starlite.xlsx (skeleton)

Hi all — quick operational checklist and a couple of asks before we start redlining:

1) Party_Roster_Starlite.xlsx: Jill, could you return the populated roster with signing authority email addresses by EOD 4/23? That lets us route signatures and billing correctly.
2) SOW questions: Evan — can you add a short note in the SOW (inline) if Starlite requires any dedicated-hosting or special encryption model? That will determine whether we add an Exhibit on residency.
3) Evidence: If you need SOC2 artifacts, please indicate the minimum set (e.g., control categories) so Redwood Security can prepare a scoped package.

Process note: once we send our initial commercial redline (tracked), we prefer to do a single 20–30m call to walk high-risk clauses rather than iterative back-and-forth. If Starlite wants to redline heavily offline instead, let us know but that can extend the timeline.
